summary: Frontend-only verification of the new IPV Communication Safety Assessment 'Listen First' audio swap on /safety-assessment. All acceptance criteria pass: (1) new asset step-ipv-assessment.mp3 serves at HTTP 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg, Content-Length 980640 bytes (~957 KB), duration 49.032s (matches the ~49s spec); (2) /safety-assessment intro card renders ListenFirstButton with data-testid='safety-assessment-listen-panel' and the toggle data-testid='safety-assessment-listen-toggle-button' — clicking play advances currentTime from 0 to ~3.14s within 3.2s and audio.paused=false; (3) panel label chip now reads 'LISTEN FIRST · FAMILY VIOLENCE ASSESSMENT' (source string 'Listen First · Family Violence Assessment', CSS-uppercased in DOM) and the subtitle heading reads 'Intimate Partner Violence — listen before you begin'; the previous 'Assess Your Family Situation' subtitle is completely removed from the page. Safety-assessment Start button still moves to Section 1 and HighConcernOverlay still triggers on a high-concern S1 Yes (s1_q1). Guest auto-bootstrap on /safety-assessment still works — a fresh guest hits /safety-assessment and stays there (no /login redirect).
